map.信息比率 IR = 平均主动收益 ÷ 跟踪误差；主动收益 = 组合收益 − 基准: Information Ratio IR = mean active return / tracking error; active return = portfolio return - benchmark return; tracking error = std dev of the active-return series (annualized by multiplying sqrt of yearly periods); the higher the IR, the more stable the excess return per unit of active risk; generally IR > 0.5 is considered good and > 1.0 excellent.

map.IR = 主动收益均值/跟踪误差 = 1.5%/2% = 0.75。IR>0.5: IR = mean active return / tracking error = 1.5%/2% = 0.75. IR > 0.5 is generally considered to show some excess-return capability.
map.主动收益均值 1.5%、TE 降到 1%：IR=1.5。TE 越小（越贴合基准却: Mean active return 1.5%, TE drops to 1%: IR = 1.5. The smaller the TE (closer to the benchmark yet still ahead), the higher the IR.
map.IR 和夏普的区别？: What is the difference between IR and Sharpe?
map.夏普用无风险利率作基准、看绝对风险调整收益；IR 用市场/业绩基准、看相对超额的: Sharpe uses the risk-free rate as the benchmark and looks at absolute risk-adjusted return; IR uses a market/performance benchmark and looks at the stability of relative excess.
map.经验上 IR>1 优秀、0.5–1 良好、<0.5 超额不稳定。但需足够长样本，: Empirically IR > 1 is excellent, 0.5-1 good, < 0.5 unstable excess. But a long enough sample is needed; short-term IR is noisy.
